# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P38](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0038), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall lad with broad shoulders, clear, straightforward eyes, and curly brown hair. He has roguish hazel eyes and a mouth often twisted into a teasing smile. As he matures, he develops a frank, handsome appearance.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is popular, frank, and highly ambitious. He possesses a playful, teasing nature, often joking or exchanging books and puzzles with his peers. Determined and steady in his goals, he holds himself to high personal ideals and shows a supportive, reliable disposition toward his friends and community.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## History

After living in Alberta for three years with his father, Gilbert returned to Avonlea to resume his schooling. On his first afternoon back in the classroom, he pulled Anne Shirley's braid and called her 'Carrots', provoking her to smash her slate over his head. Though he later attempted to apologize, Anne refused to forgive him, initiating an intense academic rivalry between the two top scholars. Over time, Gilbert maintained high marks alongside Anne, eventually entering the fifth class and continuing his studies at Queen's Academy. As he grew older, he became a local schoolteacher at White Sands and an active participant in community efforts like the Avonlea Village Improvement Society. Despite Anne's frosty discouragement of sentiment, Gilbert remained steadfast in his quiet admiration and affection for her while preparing for higher education at Redmond College.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c30 P25](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0025), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051), [v2 c19 P52](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0052), [v2 c19 P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055)_
